sanskrit: tasmiṃstīrthe sakṛtsnānā tsmaraṇātkīrtanādapi | loke tatodhikaṃ tīrthaṃ tattulyaṃ vā dvijottamāḥ || 5 ||
english: 3-9. Of the twenty-four important Tīrthas, O excellent Brāhmaṇas, the first one that is mentioned is well-known in all the worlds. By remembering that Tīrtha a devotee will cease to have rebirth in any species. Even the sins committed in the course of a hundred thousand births become dissolved by taking a single holy bath in that Tīrtha, by remembering it and by glorifying it. A Tīrtha superior to this or at least equal to it does not exist in the world, O excellent Brāhmaṇas. O excellent sages, the truth has been stated by me.
